quest.title: A sort-of epic test quest
quest.description: A test quest that includes several different aspects, lots of various rewards, two choice points (one for rewards and one for fun), optional (one-of) tasks, collections of required (all-of) tasks, and lots of other fun stuff to ensure that the GUI can cope

node.instruction: Use your fancy GM commands to add 10,000 gold to your player's back-pack... in chunks, if you want to see the counter working!
node.journal_entry: Using the mystical powers of the mysterious console, you uttered (typed) the magical words "gm_equip r_gold:10000" and 10,000 gold miraculously appeared in your back-pack and your quest moved on to the next step

node.instruction: Choose your path through the quest called test...

task.task_instruction: Select path 1, for lots of harvesting fun
Path 2 will make you craft, I hope there's a crafting station nearby
Path 3 is just about equiping stuff, or is it...

node.instruction: You must harvest something, either timber, cotton or stone, but the inferior stuff will not count...
node.journal_entry: You used your tools to harvest some stuff (no idea what, since the quest didn't branch), but I'm sure it was good, and it allows you to move on to the next tasking, complicated, mind-bending task...

task.task_instruction: Harvest timber, from a tree, and not the inferior crap
Harvest cotton, from a bush, the inferior crap doesn't count here either
Harvest stone, from a stone, I don't think there is inferior stone

node.instruction: You chose to craft, now you must live with your choice, you must craft all 3 of the crappy items listed below...
node.journal_entry: You managed to find a appropriate crafting station, and equipped all the required materials (and watched the mind-numbing bar fill up several times), you have your weapons now you can progress to the next task in this gauntlet of danger and intrigue that is the epic quest called test...

node.instruction: You must summon the ancient knowledge of "gm_equip" once more... well twice actually... as you must now add both of the items below to your back-pack (so we can test that multiple graph progression-points are supported by the GUI correctly)
node.journal_entry: Once again you defied all the perils and managed to solve all the clues, you now have everything you could ever need (a stupidly large ship, and a funny looking mask), you must now manage to juggle two progression points in the epic quest called test, to decide what you want to test next...

task.task_instruction: Summon the console and type 'gm_equip r_mask tassos'

task.resource_name: r_Figurine Ship Ship of the Line
task.task_instruction: Console again, but this time 'gm_equip r_Figurine ship ship of the line' (because one 'ship' won't do!)

node.instruction: Rest your weary bones (press h)... completing this task will end the quest...
node.journal_entry: After your struggle through the epic mind-bending quest, you can put on your Tasos mask and rest now, and use your rewards to dye your armour black...

task.task_instruction: Press 'H' (I think!) to sit on the ground

node.instruction: Now you have it, try to spawn that stupidly oversized ship (even if you fail, the quest should progress from here, since success is not a requirement of the activate item task!)
node.journal_entry: You managed to find a large enough body of water and spawnd your over-sized ship in it... or maybe you didn't, since the quest would have progressed anyway, but at least you managed to double-click an icon in your back-pack... that's something, I suppose...

task.resource_name: r_Figurine Ship Ship of the Line
task.task_instruction: Double-click the ship in your back-pack

node.journal_entry: You ran away from the dangerous, terrifying, life-threatening crafting station, with your crappy weapons secured in your back-pack, you will now receive your rewards of lots of heavy metal (or you would, if the give item action was implemented)

Somehow (I've no idea how) you figured out the cryptic puzzle and managed to press the space bar... now you will receive your amazing reward and be showered in gold (although not really, since the give item action is not yet implemented!)
You ended your epic struggle with some gold!
You worked your ass off, and you succeeded... all the Ingots are yours, you lucky tester!
After all the struggle and strife, you received (well didn't, but anyway...) your black dyes!

node.instruction: Now your ship is spawned (or isn't, I have no idea!), you must de-spawn it... actually you can de-spawn anything here, as resource type is not part of the use skill task... so just use the unspawn skill (one day we'll figure out how to be consistent with naming), and we can move on...
node.journal_entry: You unspawned/de-spawned something (hopfully the ship, but maybe just a mount)... anyway, with all this skill and knowledge gained from all of these insanely epic tasks, you must now be ready to put that knowledge and experience to good use and select your rewards... cloth or wood, it's your choice...

task.task_instruction: De-spawn something, ideally the ship, but anything will do

node.instruction: Pick one, they're both "ok" rewards... and it doesn't really matter, as you wont' actually receive either, until I implement the give item action...
node.journal_entry: You overcame all adversities and made the epic choice... How you did it without cracking under the pressure is a mystery to me!

task.task_instruction: If you need wood, pick this option

node.journal_entry: All this for some wood!!!... oh well, better luck next time!
After such an epic journey, you can now sell all this cloth to make some money, or just sit around wearing your Tasos mask!
